title: Emissions Tracking, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Emissions Tracking agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

screenshot.alt: A terminal after the one-time setup: python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help lists its commands, including aibast (CSV lists, a Draft-only agent and its managed app), ms auth status shows the signed-in account, and az account show shows the account and tenant; all identifiers are masked.
anchors: aibast: an AIBAST studio package: CSV lists, a Draft-only agent and its managed app
ms auth status: Signed in as <your account>

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the three lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Emissions Facilities list.
steps.expected: Four fictional facilities, including Ridgeline Coal Station (FAC-E03) with Scope1CO2 1,420,000 and ThresholdCO2 1,500,000.

screenshot.alt: The Emissions Facilities list that brainfreeze studio created and filled on the Easy workshop site AIBAST Synthetic Data: the four fictional facilities Riverside Generating Station, Sweetwater Wind Farm, Ridgeline Coal Station (FAC-E03, Moffat County, CO, coal_plant, 520 MW, Scope1CO2 1,420,000) and Bayshore Refinery. More columns continue to the right.

The Ridgeline Coal Station item opened from the Emissions Facilities list (its row is selected behind the form), scrolled to its last fields: Scope3CO2 95,000, ThresholdCO2 1,500,000, ReductionTargetPct 30, BaselineYear 2022 (stored as text) and BaselineCO2 1,780,000.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Emissions Tracking Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, four skills, the rules-and-controls knowledge file and three SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

screenshot.alt: The Draft agent Emissions Tracking Studio that brainfreeze studio deployed: the studio instructions, Claude Sonnet 4.6, four skills, the three list tools and the rules-and-controls knowledge file, with no web search.

steps.title: Test: Emissions Data Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Consolidate the Ridgeline scope totals and state the evidence limitation.
steps.expected: The answer reads Ridgeline Coal Station from the facilities list, totals 1,533,200 tonnes, and says it is not verified emissions evidence.

screenshot.alt: Locked case EMISSION_TRACKING-01 on the Easy Draft in a fresh Preview conversation, rerun with the 6a988a88 skills: the Get items call with table Emissions Facilities and the Easy workshop site as dataset (tenant masked), and its output starting with Riverside Generating Station FAC-E01.

The EMISSION_TRACKING-01 answer on the Easy Draft with the 6a988a88 skills: an Emissions Dashboard for Ridgeline Coal Station FAC-E03 (Moffat County, CO, coal plant, 520 MW), scope totals 1,420,000 + 18,200 + 95,000 = 1,533,200 tonnes CO2e labelled as a computation on the list record fields, 94.7% of threshold with its computation shown, and the start of the evidence limitation.

The end of the rerun EMISSION_TRACKING-01 answer on the Easy Draft: the evidence limitation that this is synthetic inventory, not verified emissions evidence, the source (the Emissions Facilities record FAC-E03, retrieved this turn), the authorized reviewer requirement, the no-write boundary and the citation.
anchors: synthetic inventory, not verified emissions evidence
Source: Emissions Facilities list record FAC-E03

steps.title: Test: Environmental Compliance Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Screen FAC-E03 against its threshold without making a legal compliance claim.
steps.expected: BELOW SCREENING THRESHOLD, and that it is not a legal compliance determination.

screenshot.alt: Locked case EMISSION_TRACKING-02 on the Easy Draft in a fresh Preview conversation, rerun with the 6a988a88 skills: one of its two Get items calls, with table Emissions Regulations and the Easy workshop site as dataset (tenant masked), and its output starting with EPA GHG Reporting Program (EPA_GHGRP, 25000, 2026-03-31). The other call read Emissions Facilities.

The EMISSION_TRACKING-02 answer on the Easy Draft with the 6a988a88 skills: Compliance Status for FAC-E03 Ridgeline Coal Station, 1,420,000 t of Scope 1 CO2 against the 1,500,000 t facility threshold, BELOW SCREENING THRESHOLD with a gap of 0 and a 30% reduction target, and a table of how each figure was derived from the Emissions Facilities list, with the 94.7% threshold share labelled as computed.

The end of the rerun EMISSION_TRACKING-02 answer on the Easy Draft: the boundary that this is a screening result only and not a legal compliance determination or an emissions claim, material uncertainties (synthetic pilot inventory; 20.2% actual reduction against the 30% target, with any compliance characterization left to an authorized reviewer; the facility threshold is distinct from the program thresholds in the Emissions Regulations list), the Environmental Compliance Manager review, the no-change statement and the citation.
anchors: No inventory record, filing, account, or system position was changed

steps.title: Test: Decarbonization Program Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What reduction scenarios exist for Ridgeline and who must review them?
steps.expected: Fuel switching to natural gas among the scenarios, and engineering, finance, environmental, and executive review.

screenshot.alt: Locked case EMISSION_TRACKING-03 on the Easy Draft in a fresh Preview conversation, with the 6a988a88 skills: the Get items call with table Emissions Facilities and the Easy workshop site as dataset (tenant masked), and its output starting with Riverside Generating Station FAC-E01.

The EMISSION_TRACKING-03 answer on the Easy Draft with the 6a988a88 skills: Emission Reduction Plans for Ridgeline Coal Station (FAC-E03) from the facility record, the 1,246,000 t target labelled as computed, current 1,420,000 t and the 174,000 t remaining gap, and the three scenarios: Fuel switching to natural gas (400,000 t, $85.0 M), Carbon capture retrofit (300,000 t, $120.0 M) and Efficiency upgrades (50,000 t, $12.0 M).
anchors: Fuel switching to natural gas 400,000 $85.0 M

screenshot.alt: The end of the EMISSION_TRACKING-03 answer on the Easy Draft: Who Must Review, stating verbatim that scenario estimates require engineering, finance, environmental, and executive review before any action is taken, the evidence and uncertainty note, the no-write boundary and the citation.

screenshot.alt: The end of the EMISSION_TRACKING-04 answer on the Easy Draft: evidence and uncertainty (list sources, computed values labelled, the 2025 and 2026 vintages from the records), the Sustainability Lead review requirement for a due-diligence shortlist only, the boundary that no credit purchase, retirement, disclosure, or offset claim has been made or implied, and the citation.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Copy the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: emissions-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the three lists.

screenshot.alt: A terminal after getting the app's source: brainfreeze studio's managed-app command writes the Emissions Tracking Workspace (a read-only scenario workspace over the three SharePoint lists) to emissions-app/managed-app, the sed command sets the site in src/config.ts to the Manual workshop site (tenant masked), and grep shows the site and the three list names.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Emissions Tracking Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Facilities" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Carbon Offsets" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Regulations" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the three tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Emissions Tracking Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and look at Ridgeline Coal Station.
steps.expected: Ridgeline's total is 1,533,200 t and its scope 1 share of threshold is 94.7%: the same figures the agent gave, from the same list.
